info.title: Quire API
info.description: The public API of Quire, a self-hosted wiki. The web client uses it with its session cookie; external clients and the `quire` CLI use personal access tokens (`Authorization: Bearer qpat_…`). Errors have the shape `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"?}, "request_id"}`; clients treat an unknown `code` by its HTTP status. Within v1, changes are additive only.

get.summary: The current user, the workspace, and how this request was authenticated (`auth.token` for a token).

post.summary: Creates a collection (last, unless `position` says otherwise).

get.summary: The document's Yjs state: the whole update, or with `since` only what that state vector lacks.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Base64 Yjs state vector: return only what the client is missing.

200.description: The Yjs state (base64 v1 update and state vector)

get.summary:
The document as Quire Markdown 1 (§6.4). Never 304: it prints live titles. The lossy steps are listed in
`Quire-Conversion-Warnings`.

put.summary:
Writes the document from Markdown (§6.4): a diff against the `If-Match` base, stored as one Yjs update. A stale
`If-Match` is 412 (`details.mergeable`), unless the document already equals the target (200 `changed: false`)
or `?merge=true` merges it with the newer updates. Only `text/markdown` is accepted.

parameters.name: merge
parameters.description: Merge with newer updates when `If-Match` is stale but still reconstructible (D50).

200.description: Written (or already equal), with the new `ETag`

get.summary:
The document as normalized ProseMirror JSON (`editor.getJSON()`, §6.4), `ETag: "d{seq}"`; 304 for a matching
`If-None-Match`.

put.summary:
Writes the document from ProseMirror JSON (§6.4): validated against schema v1 (422 `invalid_document` with a
JSON pointer), then diffed against the `If-Match` base by `blockId` and content, and stored as one Yjs update.

200.description: Written (or already equal), with the new `ETag`

post.summary:
Saves one Yjs update (§6.1): 409 `missing_deps` with the server's state vector when it depends on structs the
server lacks; a re-sent update is a no-op. A token's first write after someone else's stores a `pre-api`
revision (D53).

requestBody.description: A base64 Yjs v1 update (up to 16 MiB), and the editor's JSON

get.summary: The OpenAPI 3.1 document of this API.

Document schema v1 as data: every node and mark with its attrs, types, defaults and content rules (§6.4); the
nodes and marks a ProseMirror PUT may use.
The caller's live tokens and expired ones (not revoked), newest first, at most 100. Never the secret or its hash.

post.summary: Creates a token; the response is the only place its secret ever appears.
post.description:
Scopes cannot exceed the caller's; a calling token cannot grant `admin` (403 `session_required`) and the new
token cannot outlive it (422, `field: "expires_in_days"`). A session sends `password` for an `admin` or
never-expiring token (422, `field: "password"`, when missing or wrong). At most 100 live tokens per user.

delete.summary: Revokes the calling token itself (`quire auth logout --revoke`), and the tokens it created.
Revokes a token of the caller, and the tokens it created. Takes effect on the next request.

404.description: `not_found`: no live token of the caller has this id

ApiToken.description: A personal access token as lists show it. Never the secret or its hash.

parent_token_id.description: The token that created this one; it is revoked with it (D42).

prefix.description: The first 12 characters of the token (`qpat_` + 7), for recognizing it.

AttrSpec.description: An attribute of a node or mark.

default.description: The default value (`null` when the attr has none).

type.description:
The JSON type in TypeScript notation, e.g. `integer`, `boolean`, `string | null`, `integer[] | null`,
`"info" | "tip"`.

AuthMethodKind.description: How the current request was authenticated.

ChildOrder.description: How a collection orders its items in the tree. Non-manual orders are computed at read time.

icon.description: A lucide icon name; `null` shows a letter tile.

item_count.description: Live items in the collection, at every depth.

ConversionWarning.description: One kind of lossy step, with where it first happened and how often.

path.description: A JSON pointer, or `line:column` for Markdown input.

ConversionWarningCode.description: A lossy step of a conversion (§6.4 table). New codes may be added within v1.

CreatedToken.description: Response of `POST /tokens`: the only response that ever contains the secret.

doc.description: Normalized ProseMirror JSON `{type: "doc", content}` (the shape of `editor.getJSON()`, §6.4).
ProseMirror JSON `{type: "doc", content}`; missing attrs get their defaults.

DocSchema.description:
Response of `GET /schema/doc`: schema v1 as data (`quire-core::schema`, §6.4), byte for byte
`fixtures/schema/v1.json`, which the web fixture writer dumps from the live TipTap schema.

nodes.description: In schema order (ProseMirror's own `doc` and `text` included).

seq.description: The newest stored update (the document ETag is `"d{seq}"`).

state_vector.description: Base64 Yjs state vector of the server's document.

pm_json.description: The editor's ProseMirror JSON after the update (a cache; rebuildable).

state_vector.description: Base64 Yjs state vector after the update.

DocWriteResult.description: Response of the Markdown and ProseMirror PUTs, with the new `ETag`.

changed.description: `false` when the document already equalled the target (nothing was written).

merged.description: `true` when the write was merged with newer updates (`?merge=true` or `If-Match: *`).

request_id.description: The `X-Request-Id` of the response. Always set by the server; `null` only in errors the CLI raises itself.

MarkSpec.description: A mark type of the document schema.

excludes.description: The ProseMirror `excludes` expression: null excludes only the mark itself, `_` every mark.

inclusive.description: Whether the mark extends to text typed at its end (null: ProseMirror's default, true).

rank.description: Position in the schema's mark order (marks are sorted by it).

expires_in_days.description:
1–3650. Omitted: 90 days; `null`: never (a session must then send `password`; a calling token's expiry caps
it).

password.description: The session's password, required for an `admin` or never-expiring token.

scopes.description: At most the caller's scopes; a calling token can never grant `admin`.

NodeSpec.description: A node type of the document schema.

content.description: The ProseMirror content expression, e.g. `inline*`; null for a leaf.

marks.description:
The marks allowed in this node's content: null for ProseMirror's default (every mark in inline content),
`""` for none, `"_"` for all, otherwise mark names.

Position.description:
A position among siblings (or collections, or stars). The server computes the sort key (D6). With both ids
omitted (or `null`) the row goes last.

after_id.description: Place the row right after this sibling.

before_id.description: Place the row right before this sibling.

Role.description: A user's role (lookup table `user_roles`). M1 has a single owner.

Scope.description:
A token scope. The hierarchy is `read` ⊂ `write` ⊂ `admin` (the variant order); a session has every scope.
`read`: every GET except token and session management and export; `write`: content and structure; `admin`:
purge, workspace and account settings, sessions, tokens, export and backup (§7.3).

Timestamp.description:
A point in time. Unix milliseconds in Rust and SQL (D5); on the wire an RFC 3339 UTC string with millisecond
precision, e.g. `2026-10-28T09:30:00.000Z`. Parsing accepts any RFC 3339 offset and fraction (truncated to
milliseconds).

User.description: A user, as every response shows it.

bearer.description: A personal access token, `qpat_` + 46 base62 characters, with the scopes read ⊂ write ⊂ admin.

session.name: quire_session
session.description: The web client's session cookie. Over HTTPS (behind the proxy) it is named `__Host-quire_session`. A session has every scope; cookie-authenticated mutations must pass the Fetch-Metadata / Origin check.
